about_the_game:
Tie your gloves on tight and travel the world, but don’t write cheques your fists can’t cash. Idolize the strong, be weary of the weak, and carry a knuckle sandwich for later. The World of Heavyweights Pack contains 2 Legendary Outfits, 4 cell items and one player icon.   

 The World of Heavyweights Pack includes the following: 

  • King of the Ring Suit 

  • Billion Dollar Toddler Suit 

  • Boxing Gloves cell item 

  • Cursed Idol cell item 

  • Monkey Skull cell item 

  • Shrunken Head cell item 

  • A player icon
